customc/* =============================== COMMERCIAL WIDGET – ALL IN ONE =============================== */ .commercial-widget { background: linear-gradient( 135deg, #1db954 0%, #ffffff 50%, #0b5ed7 100% ); padding: 30px; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12); height: 100%; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.4s ease, box-shadow 0.4s ease; } /* Hover floating card */ .commercial-widget:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); } /* Floating animated background glow */ .commercial-widget::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -50%; left: -50%; width: 200%; height: 200%; background: radial-gradient( circle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) 0%, transparent 60% ); animation: floatBg 8s infinite linear; pointer-events: none; } /* Floating background animation */ @keyframes floatBg { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } /* Floating heading text */ .commercial-widget h2 { color: #0b5ed7; margin-bottom: 15px; font-weight: 700; position: relative; animation: floatText 3s ease-in-out infinite; } /* Heading animation */ @keyframes floatText { 0% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-6px); } 100% { transform: translateY(0); } } /* Paragraph styling */ .commercial-widget p { color: #222; font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 18px; } /* List styling */ .commercial-widget ul { padding-left: 0; list-style: none;
